author: GamingBolt
description:
It’s been available on other platforms for a while, but now Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is finally coming to Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2. However, today we’re focusing solely on Microsoft’s home console system as there are numerous Xbox-specific features and enhancements that are worth highlighting. 

From visual upgrades and performance options, to cross-platform benefits and bonus content, here are fifteen things you need to know.
title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth Xbox Series X | S - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Two million copies sold, and Subnautica 2 has arrived in style. The long wait for a title with a troubled development cycle is over, and the Pioneers have arrived on a planet that’s hiding most of its secrets quite well. The ones on offer are compelling enough to keep the Pioneers occupied, though, and the game has managed to capture the hearts and minds of fans and newcomers alike.

How has it done that? Join us as we take a look at how Subnautica 2 is keepings its players submerged in its mysteries, and the potential that its new alien planet is bringing to a game that’s looking like it's going to be a treat for those who stand by it.
title: Subnautica 2 - Why Are Millions Addicted?

author: GamingBolt
description: As a random commenter said, “Does the developer actually sleep?” Because just days after the massive patch 1.06 for Crimson Desert, it's released patch 1.07. No, not a hotfix – a full-fledged patch. Sure, it's not as big as previous updates, but it still offers some pretty significant new additions, especially for unarmed combat enthusiasts. Without further ado, let's go over 10 of the biggest changes, starting with...
title: Crimson Desert Is Becoming Unstoppable - 10 More Massive Changes In The Latest Patch
